f4 offset 54 = IPv4 无 options TCP payload 起点

summary: Full connection handshake: protocol header -> start/start-ok/tune/tune-ok/open/open-ok

所有 connection 方法 channel=0; packet 索引为近似值,依实现可有偏移

notes: channel.open(20/10)->open-ok(20/11)->channel.close(20/40)->close-ok(20/41)->connection.close(10/50)->close-ok(10/51)
amqp.session.method 对应 class 20 (channel); 业务 channel 1

summary: Heartbeat frame: type=8, channel=0, size=0, end=CE

notes: Heartbeat 固定 8 字节: 08(type=8) 00 00(channel=0) 00 00 00 00(size=0) ce(end)
amqp.type=8, amqp.channel=0, amqp.length=0; 心跳在连接 open 后发送

summary: exchange.declare (direct) + queue.declare with respective ok responses

notes: exchange.declare(40/10)->declare-ok(40/11)->queue.declare(50/10)->declare-ok(50/11)

summary: basic.publish -> HEADER (class=60) -> BODY with BodySize match

notes: basic.publish(60/70)->HEADER(class=60)->BODY('Hello!' 6B); BodySize=6 由生成器按 body 事件自动累加
amqp.message.method=80 对应 basic.publish; amqp.type=2=HEADER, 3=BODY

summary: Body > frame_max auto-split into multiple BODY frames; reassembled length equals BodySize

notes: frame_max=128, body 200B 超 frame_max-8, 生成器自动拆成多个 BODY frame, JSON 不写分段
断言: 至少出现 type=3 BODY frame (distinct), Header BodySize=200=重组 body 总长; 单帧线上长度 7+Size+1<=frame_max

summary: basic.consume -> basic.deliver -> HEADER -> BODY -> basic.ack on same channel

amqp.message.method 对应 class 60 (basic) 方法 ID; 全部在同一 channel 1

summary: basic.get followed by explicit basic.get-empty response

summary: AMQP 0-9-1 protocol header over TCP/IPv6, application bytes unchanged

notes: IPv6 外层: TCP payload 起点 offset 74 (14 Eth+40 IPv6+20 TCP); 协议头字节与 IPv4 相同
ipv6.nxt=6 验证 TCP Next Header; 应用层 bytes 不变

summary: Frame boundary: heartbeat size=0, BodySize=0 with HEADER, frame_max edge
